description: Emotion battery. The existing 10 cases are emotionally flat (every dump has zero emotion), so the avatar pose port had probe goldens but no corpus-level exercise. This drives the textpose rules that actually fire - caps->SHOUT, !!!, greetings->WAVE, I/You->POINT, LOL/ROTFL, smileys - as a *sequence*, because GetBodyFromEmotion carries m_lastBody/Face/Torso history between messages (Tier-1 #2, Tier-3 #7). Seed differs from the 42 used by 001-010 so the LCG stream itself gets fresh coverage.
